Package layout decided by Jack Heart (quotes and full table in scratch/questions.md, "Package layout"), in this Task ("do it in 56"): top-level etude/run.py holds the shared Run base (declare, delivery, RunState/RunCounters, listing); TrainingRun(Run) lives in etude/train/tracking and is what track() returns; EvalRun(Run) is what evaluate() runs as, evaluate() keeps its one-call shape; errors, storage, records, checkpoints become top-level modules; etude.tracking goes away. Layout test: etude.run and those modules import no train/eval/launch; train and eval do not import each other. Existing etude.experiment.TrainingRun -> TrainingRunSummary, eval.match.EvalRun -> EvalResult. Warning aliases until 0.5.
